mapper.select: select professional_role_id, role_code, role_name, role_description, system_flag, status, sort_order, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from pm_professional_role where professional_role_id = #{id}

select professional_role_id, role_code, role_name, role_description, system_flag, status, sort_order, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from pm_professional_role where role_code = #{roleCode} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into pm_professional_role( role_code, role_name, role_description, system_flag, status, sort_order, create_by, create_time ) values ( #{roleCode}, #{roleName}, #{roleDescription}, #{systemFlag}, #{status}, #{sortOrder}, #{createBy}, sysdate() )
mapper.update: update pm_professional_role set role_code = #{roleCode}, role_name = #{roleName}, role_description = #{roleDescription}, status = #{status}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where professional_role_id = #{professionalRoleId} and system_flag = '0'
mapper.delete: delete from pm_professional_role where professional_role_id = #{id} and system_flag = '0'
mapper.select: select count(*) from pm_project_member where professional_role_id = #{id} and status = 'ACTIVE'
